name: CircleLoop
description_en:
CircleLoop is a product in the Call center category. Its directory profile covers Outbound Call Center, Inbound Call Center, Concurrency Support, Live Chat, Progressive Dialer, Predictive Dialer, Queue Management (Calls), IVR Support.

Additional listed capabilities include Auto Call Recording, Call Monitoring. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud) Mobile App (Android, iOS) Desktop App (Windows, Mac). The listed organization sizes are Medium Business Small Business Freelancers. API support is listed as NA. Support channels are listed as Business Hours, Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Starts at $6.45.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: exchange messages with visitors or customers in real time. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
description_zh:
CircleLoop 属于呼叫中心软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括外呼中心、呼入中心、并发支持、在线聊天、渐进式拨号器、预测式拨号器、通话队列管理、交互式语音应答支持。

资料还列出自动通话录音、通话监控。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务） 移动应用 (Android, iOS) 桌面应用 (Windows, Mac)。资料所列适用组织规模为中型企业 小型企业 自由职业者。API 支持情况为未注明。资料所列支持方式为工作时间支持, 在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：提供免费试用 起价为 $6.45.。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：与访客或客户实时交换消息。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。
